summary: European Investment Bank filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $4.0 billion offering of 4.375% notes due November 25, 2031. Notes priced at 99.792% of par, implying $3,991,680,000 in public offering proceeds before a 0.125% underwriting discount ($5,000,000), leaving $3,986,680,000 net to the EIB. Interest pays semi-annually May 25 and November 25, first coupon November 25, 2026; settlement expected August 25, 2026. Notes are unsecured, unsubordinated, non-redeemable, listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. Barclays, Deutsche Bank and RBC Capital Markets are underwriters. Routine sovereign supranational debt issuance, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle.
